svg.aria-label: STAR breakdown of the ServiceNow GenAI app-from-prompt architect story
svg.text: New AI-native product: generate a working app from a plain-text prompt.
No playbook; the LLM is non-deterministic — output isn't guaranteed valid.
Core architect: own it end to end into a production AI-native system.
A · Action (what I did) — owned 3 layers
LLM ORCHESTRATION — drive the model in stages: prompt → structured app.
PROMPT MANAGEMENT — version + structure prompts so behavior is repeatable.
OUTPUT VALIDATION — check every generation before it reaches the user
(the responsible-AI / trust layer); modular so each layer evolves independently.
Shipped a production GenAI product: plain-text prompt → generated app. [metrics FILL IN]
Lesson: orchestrate in stages, manage prompts like code, validate before you show.
Signals: technical leadership · building new under ambiguity · end-to-end AI ownership · responsible AI
Model, scale, and quality/adoption numbers are placeholders — fill in the real values before using this story.
